
deploy-bot: Canary deploy 2026-03-19T22:04Z -> AWQ actq group=64 flagged by anomaly detector, auto-scaled +2 nodes

elisabeth: agreed. can someone run AB: group [32,48,64,96] x actq [on,off] with prefix cache enabled/disabled
kevin: queued a job: `./run_sweep --groups 32,48,64,96 --actq on,off --workload bursty` ETA ~4h
sara: also add eval hooks to capture ngram-match and ppl, and a small prompt set for hallucination checks
aj: if regen persists after rollback, we can pin to previous quant profile (qpf) model variant
elisabeth: rolling back canary now to baseline awq_group=96, actq=off :thumbsup:
